coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 RC6 这一种 128 位块、20 轮的 AES 候选分组密码：RC6-w/r/b 参数、四寄存器加解密、乘法-旋转混合、P/Q 密钥调度、小端字节序、提交文档的六组向量和 2018 年草案的独立向量；不把 RC5、AES、其他 AES 候选者、工作模式或整个库并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the RC6 128-bit-block, 20-round AES candidate: the RC6-w/r/b parameters, four-register encryption/decryption, multiplication-rotation mixing, P/Q key schedule, little-endian byte order, the six submission vectors and the independent 2018 draft vector. It does not absorb RC5, AES, the other AES candidates, modes of operation or the whole library.
